description: Fork of exp742 (bf16 head + xent inside autocast, base = exp737 v2 with bf16 LUT storage + fp32 master Lion). Single change: device_batch_size 24 -> 48 so grad_accum drops 2 -> 1. Tests the hypothesis that bf16 .grad accumulation under grad_accum=2 was compounding bf16 head noise. exp743 attempted this but was killed at step 1400 at +8 mb drift; exp748 runs to step 4000 for the full picture. Note: dbs change shifts data-packing slightly (best-fit packing optimizes per-call). Compare to exp737 v2 = 1.3872.
